name: Portfolio
summary: Invest USDC into a weighted token basket and keep it rebalanced across the chains you choose
description: Invest settlement currency toward a global weighted token basket. Bridge native USDC through CCTP and use Across for USDC/USDG routes where configured. Buys spend available funds on under-target assets in basket order.
strategy: Hold a global weighted token basket. Buy under-target holdings with idle settlement currency in basket order. Trim overweight holdings when the configured band and cadence permit. Use configured liquid routes and pool bridge requests by destination.
mandate: A swap permission to buy and sell tokens through the router, a bounded approve permission, a CCTP bridge permission to move USDC between native-USDC chains (locked to the account's own address on the destination), and an Across bridge permission for chains CCTP does not reach (Robinhood Chain, in USDG), with depositor and recipient locked to the account and an output floor.
author: aadopico
